login.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.

connection.tooltip: SSE stream — resumed by cursor on reconnect (§8.1).

channels.title: Channels
channels.empty: No channels. Access comes from a group in your identity provider or an invitation (§5.1).

console.title: Platform console
console.description: Metadata and operations. Channel content isn't readable from here: joining a channel is the explicit path, and it's audited (§5.4).

forbidden.title: This console is reserved for the platform role.
forbidden.description: It's declared in GitOps ([admin] oidc_groups, §11) and no API can grant it — so there's nobody to ask here: it's a configuration change.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.none: No pass completed on this replica yet. The boot pass runs before the socket opens, so seeing this means it failed.
reconciliation.lastPass: Last pass {at} ({trigger}) · {channels} channels · {accounts} service accounts · {removed} removed
reconciliation.pending: {count} binding(s) waiting on a first sign-in:
reconciliation.perReplica: Figures for this replica: unlike the purge, all of them reconcile (§11), so two reads can differ by a tick.

channels.title: Channels · {count}
channels.joinHint: "Join" adds the reader to the channel with subscribe only and writes an audit entry. On a managed channel, reconciliation will take membership back over: durable access is written in config (§11).

policies.title: Trust policies · {count}
policies.none: None. No CI job can exchange a token on this instance (§5.3).
policies.readOnlyHint: Read-only: config owns them (§11), so an edit button would offer what the next reconciliation would take back.

dlq.title: Stuck deliveries · {count}
dlq.none: Nothing stuck. A delivery lands here after 24 h of failures, or immediately if the consumer answered something that won't change — a 410, for instance (§7.1bis).
dlq.retryHint: "Retry" requeues the delivery with its failure count reset, and writes an audit entry. The event's content isn't shown here: reading it would require being a member of the channel (§5.4).

mintedKey.title: Copy this key now
mintedKey.description: It will never be shown again: only its hash is stored. Losing it means revoking it and creating another.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Retention and receipts, per channel. A managed channel comes from config: the API refuses it, and the next reconciliation would undo the change anyway.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Revoking a device cuts its push and its sync cursor.
devices.empty: No device. The CLI enrols one with notify device enrol.

keys.title: API keys
keys.create: Create — the secret only ever appears once

accounts.title: Service accounts
accounts.description: A team bot never runs on a human's key: someone leaving the company must not turn off the deployment.

emptyFiltered.title: No notification matches these filters.
emptyFiltered.hint: Filters are in the left column.

emptyDefault.title: Nothing to read. That's a good sign.
emptyDefault.hint: New notifications arrive here in real time.

commandPalette.searchPlaceholder: Search for a notification, channel, screen…

refused.unavailable: This deployment doesn't do Web Push.
refused.denied: Notifications are refused for this site.

prompt.title: Enable notifications?
prompt.body: Get notifications even when the tab is closed. Adjustable anytime in Settings.
prompt.fallbackError: Subscription failed. Try again, or later from Settings.

row.lateTooltip: Published {at}, received by this client just now.

image.failed: The attached image could not be displayed.

detail.emptyTitle: Select a notification to see its timeline.
detail.expiredBody: Its retention period has elapsed; the content is no longer kept (§7.2bis).
detail.deletedBody: Its author withdrew it. Clients have removed it from their inbox.
detail.noGroupTotal: Access to this channel comes from a group: the total is not known to the server (§14.2).
detail.deviceCount: The count is in people, never in devices (§7.3) · {count} device(s) received it.
detail.noBody: No body — the title says it all.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: A field you edit becomes yours: your identity provider stops overwriting it at every sign-in.
profile.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 512 KiB max. Resized to 256×256 and stripped of its metadata server-side.
profile.timezoneHint: Used as the default for quiet hours. Checked against the IANA database.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.detailHint: Where a notification's timeline opens next to the list — no effect on a narrow screen, where it always takes the whole screen.

keys.title: CLI token
keys.description: For notify login (terminal, TUI): pick the channels and what the token may do there, then paste the secret at the prompt.
keys.mintedHint: Copy this token now — paste it at the notify login prompt. It will never be shown again.
keys.create: Create — the secret only ever appears once

session.title: Session
session.groups: Groups carried by your token: {groups} — channel access follows from them on every request.

dnd.title: Do not disturb
dnd.description: OS push is suppressed during a quiet period; the stream keeps flowing and the inbox fills up normally. On the way out, a single summary rather than a burst.
dnd.noWindows: No window yet. The one-off silence above is still available.
dnd.midnightHint: Crosses midnight: the window belongs to the day it {emphasis} — a Friday 22:00–08:00 is Friday night into Saturday.
dnd.exceptionsHint: Silence everything {emphasis} the one that matters — the on-call case.
dnd.scopeRestricted: Scope is restricted to specific channels; for now it's changed from the CLI (notify dnd).
dnd.urgentBypassHint: You decide what can wake you, never the sender.

push.title: Push notifications
push.description: Receive notifications even when the tab is closed. This browser becomes a {device}: it appears in Admin → Devices, and revoking it there cuts its push and its sync cursor.
push.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push — usually a private window or an insecure origin.
push.unavailable: This deployment doesn't do Web Push: no VAPID key is configured. The real-time stream keeps working.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. The browser won't ask again: you need to re-allow them in the site's settings.

problem.scopeMissing: You don't have the rights for this action on this channel.
problem.channelUnknown: This channel doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.
problem.fieldMissing: The form is missing a piece of information.
problem.fieldInvalid: A value in the form isn't valid.
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests — try again in a moment.
problem.actionUnknown: This action no longer exists on this revision.
problem.networkDown: The server is unreachable. Check your connection, or that it's running.
